description: Updates the vanilla DPS numbers to account for attack infusers, mitochondria, mutations, and more

godot.description_rich:
Replaces the vanilla DPS display with accurate calculated values that account for all combat modifiers.

Features:
- Replaces weapon tooltip DPS with exact calculated values, accounting for infusors, mutations, mitochondria, and plasmids
- Shows per-infusor DPS contributions inline in tooltips (e.g. "Triosome **+43 DPS**")
- Displays charged DPS deltas
- Shows before/after DPS comparison when combining or upgrading organelles
- Displays total base and charged DPS in the editor stats area
- Previews DPS when hovering a weapon over a slot, showing what infusors would connect

Fully accounts for:
- Connected infusors
- Mitochondria
- Mutations
- Plasmids from meta-progression
- Enhanced slots
- Cell evolutions

name: dpspp
